layers.note: An understory shrub of moist conifer forest, rooting in rotten logs and stumps.

heat_load.note: Favours cool, shaded aspects and ravines; scarce on hot south-west slopes.

elevation_m.note: Sea level to about 900 m in western Washington; the upper limits are loose.

shade_tolerance.note: Very shade tolerant: grows under closed conifer canopy.

sun_tolerance.note: Grows best in shade on rotting wood; in clearings it persists but grows poorly.
